extracted.name: Huckleberry Buckle
extracted.description: This huckleberry buckle recipe is made with sugar, huckleberries, and butter, creating a unique cobbler-like pastry baked below the tangy fruit filling.
ingredient_lines: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter, cut into pieces
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C.) Grease the bottom of a 9-inch square pan.
Beat ½ cup sugar and ¼ cup butter in a large bowl with an electric mixer until creamy.
Combine flour, baking powder, and salt in a small bowl: stir mixture into butter mixture. Stir in milk until thick and slightly lumpy. Spread batter into the prepared pan.
Combine remaining ¾ cup sugar, berries, and boiling water in a large bowl; pour over batter in the pan. Dot with butter over top.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 to 50 minutes.
